data.one_liner: Generates a Dart class containing information from pubspec.yaml.
data.what_it_does: Auto-generates a Dart class from your pubspec.yaml file, containing app description, dependencies, and version. This keeps application metadata up-to-date across your project via build_runner or a CLI utility.
use_when: You need to access app version and description programmatically in your code.
You want consistent app metadata across multiple platforms automatically.
avoid_when: You do not use build_runner or code generation in your project workflow.
You only need standard package info without generated files.
strengths: Automates keeping app metadata synchronized with pubspec.yaml.
Supports cross-platform compatibility and command-line usage.
weaknesses: Requires setting up build_runner configuration in a build.yaml file.
Adds an extra generated file to your codebase.
data.setup_notes: Add build_runner and pubspec_generator to dev_dependencies, create a build.yaml file for output path configuration, and run build_runner.

alternatives.name: pubspec_parse
alternatives.why_pick_it: Parses pubspec.yaml files programmatically without requiring code generation.

data.minimal_example:
dev_dependencies:
  build_runner: ^2.4.0
  pubspec_generator: ^5.0.2

# Run:
# dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs
